# Mudassir Javed — Data Analyst Portfolio

> Mudassir Javed is a Data Analyst with an MSc in Statistics, specializing in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics. Practical experience across data analytics, technology, and automation.

## Core Profile
- **Role:** Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst
- **Education:** Master of Science (MSc) in Statistics, University of Balochistan
- **Core Competencies:** Business Intelligence, Exploratory Data Analysis, Data Cleaning, Data Validation, Statistical Methods, Automation, REST API Telemetry Ingestion, Dashboard Design
- **Key Tools:** SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, Git, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Website:** https://mudassiranalyst.vercel.app/

## Selected Projects & Technical Case Studies

### 1. Saylani Student Registration System
- **Canonical URL:** https://mudassiranalyst.vercel.app/projects/saylani-registration
- **Focus:** Data Collection & Intake Automation
- **Role:** Frontend & Workflow Developer
- **Live Application:** https://saylanireg.netlify.app/
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/mudassirdandor/saylani-form
- **Summary:** Automated student data collection system with client-side input validation, dynamic image preprocessing, and digital credential generation.

### 2. Job Application Data Collection System
- **Canonical URL:** https://mudassiranalyst.vercel.app/projects/job-application
- **Focus:** Structured Data & Progressive Form Architecture
- **Role:** Frontend Developer
- **Live Application:** https://jobapplica.netlify.app/
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/mudassirdandor/multi-step-form
- **Summary:** Multi-step employment application workflow with field-level validation gates, real-time completion tracking, and pre-submission data verification.

### 3. Barish Alert — Weather Application
- **Canonical URL:** https://mudassiranalyst.vercel.app/projects/barish-alert
- **Focus:** API Data Ingestion & Metric Reporting
- **Role:** Frontend & API Integration Developer
- **Live Application:** https://barishalert.netlify.app/
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/mudassirdandor/weatherapp
- **Summary:** Responsive weather intelligence dashboard that ingests live meteorological data and 5-day forecasts via OpenWeatherMap APIs with client-side unit transformations, exponential backoff retries, and local caching.
